description: Fix pagination bugs against a stated contract.
prompt: Task files are under ./workspace/ relative to your working directory; every path below is relative to ./workspace/. repo/paginate.mjs has bugs. paginate(items, page, size) uses 1-based pages and returns { items, page, totalPages }: totalPages is the number of pages needed to show every item (at least 1), items is a new array holding that page's items, and a page beyond totalPages throws RangeError. Non-array items throws TypeError; a page or size that is not a positive safe integer throws RangeError. Fix the module without renaming its export. Keep every module a self-contained ES module that imports only other files under repo/ by relative path: no packages, file access, network or subprocesses.
